children: Veritas, a US-headquartered global supplier of rubber, plastic, aluminium, and steel cooling, fluid management, and climate control solutions for automotive industry, has completed a new manufacturing facility in Morocco.
The plant in the Northwestern Tangier city is Veritas’ first location in Morocco and its first anywhere in Africa.
It also stands as the company’s first brownfield manufacturing project since HDT Automotive Solutions acquired a large part of Germany-based Veritas AG in 2024, bringing the two businesses together.

The investment strengthens Veritas’ ability to serve original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and Tier 1 suppliers, many of which are expanding their manufacturing footprint in Morocco and across North Africa.
Veritas presented the move as part of a broader effort to align its manufacturing footprint more closely with customer demand and global growth, it said in a statement carried by Morocco’s press.
Patrick Paige, president and CEO of Veritas, called the Morocco presence “an important step” in the company’s global growth strategy.
He said the project strengthens the “global manufacturing network,” enhances support for customers, and positions Veritas “for future opportunities in an ever-changing and dynamic market.”
The Tangier facility spans 5,000 square metres (sqm), including 3,835 sqm of production space, and features extrusion capabilities.
Production is scheduled to begin in the third quarter of 2027.
(Writing by N Saeed; Editing by Anoop Menon)

title: US’ automotive supplier Veritas sets up plant in Morocco
